'''Hestilic''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. [[Budhila Hestilic Amura]], creator of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Council of Elders]], was a member of this clan.
